name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Belgrade, watching Formula One races with his father. This early fascination led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in aerodynamics. Upon graduation, he joined a small rally team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous approach and problem-solving skills. Nikola believes in fostering a collaborative environment where engineers can freely experiment and push boundaries. His focus on data analysis and innovative solutions has consistently led to improved performance for his teams.

After several successful years in rallying, Nikola transitioned to circuit racing, drawn by the greater technical complexity. He has a reputation for his calm demeanor under pressure, a trait that has proven invaluable during critical moments in races. Nikola's leadership style emphasizes clear communication and empowering his team to take ownership of their work. He is known for his commitment to continuous improvement, constantly seeking new technologies and methodologies to enhance performance.

Nikola joined Full Time Sports three years ago, and his impact has been immediate. He implemented a new simulation program that has significantly reduced the time required for setup optimization. He is constantly searching for marginal gains, and his relentless pursuit of performance has earned him the respect of both his team and his rivals.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly aligned desk, even at the racetrack.
